def priority(f):

    rd = f['return_distance']

    p = f['progress']
    cd = f['cluster_density']
    spread = f['spread']
    return -d + 0.20 * rd * (1 + 0.5 * p) + 0.10 * r - 0.08 * nr + 0.05 * cd - 0.03 * spread
```
